frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
frontmatter.excerpt: In today's highly connected world, the internet has become an integral part of our daily lives. At the core of this vast network lies the Domain Name System (DNS), a critical component that helps us navigate the web with ease. Despite its importance, the DNS often remains a mystery to many. In this blog post, we will unravel the complexities of DNS, explaining how it works and why it's essential for the smooth functioning of the internet.
frontmatter.subheading: A Comprehensive Guide to the Domain Name System and its Inner Workings
frontmatter.title: Demystifying DNS: Understanding the Backbone of the Internet
